---
description: "Use when working with i18n translation files in tests/advanced/i18n/. Covers multi-language assertion text management and the texts object structure."
applyTo: "tests/advanced/i18n/**"
---

# i18n Guidelines

## Purpose

All user-facing text assertions use a structured `texts` object instead of hardcoded strings. This enables:

- Multi-language test execution (switch via `TEST_LANG` env var)
- Single place to update when UI text changes
- Readable assertion code: `texts.login.submitButton` vs `'Log In'`

## Structure

```
tests/advanced/i18n/
├── en.ts         # English translations
├── cs.ts         # Czech translations
├── types.ts      # AppTexts interface
└── index.ts      # Exports resolved texts based on TEST_LANG
```

## Types

```typescript
export interface AppTexts {
  login: {
    title: string;
    submitButton: string;
    errorInvalidCredentials: string;
  };
  dashboard: {
    title: string;
    // ...
  };
  sidebar: {
    dashboard: string;
    projects: string;
    defects: string;
    // ...
  };
  // ... one key per page/component
}
```

## Language Files

Each language file exports a const satisfying `AppTexts`:

```typescript
// en.ts
export const en: AppTexts = {
  login: {
    title: "Login",
    submitButton: "Log In",
    errorInvalidCredentials: "Invalid username or password",
  },
  // ...
};
```

## Index — Language Resolution

```typescript
import { en } from "./en";
import { cs } from "./cs";

const languages = { en, cs } as const;
const lang = (process.env.TEST_LANG || "en") as keyof typeof languages;

export const texts: AppTexts = languages[lang];
```

## Usage in Tests and Page Objects

```typescript
import { texts } from "../i18n";

await expect(page.getByTestId("login-btn-submit")).toHaveText(
  texts.login.submitButton,
);
```

## Adding a New Language

1. Create `tests/advanced/i18n/<lang>.ts` implementing `AppTexts`.
2. Add it to the `languages` map in `index.ts`.
3. Add an npm script: `"test:<lang>": "cross-env TEST_LANG=<lang> npx playwright test tests/advanced/"`.
